trimmed: heldout.json: predicted grids dropped (correct flags kept) for 6 runs: ext_source_s2_g20, ext_source_s2_g40, ext_source_s3_g20, ext_source_s3_g40, ext_source_s4_g20, ext_source_s4_g40
transcripts.json: player transcripts sampled 60 of 1513 available; prompt grids elided; capped at ~8192 chars
transcripts.json: coach transcripts sampled 12; each turn clipped to 900 chars, whole transcript capped at ~10240 chars
trees.json: each node diff capped at 6144 chars (head + last 800 chars); binary (.pyc) sections omitted
excluded: gateway call tokens ('token' in meta_steps.jsonl / ledger) are never copied
ledger rows are aggregated, never copied

summary.json.headline: one-line verdict from analysis.json
summary.json.sets: sizes of the held-out exam and the two practice sets
summary.json.B0: A_0 with two plain attempts on the held-out exam: reps (list of scores), mean, sd
summary.json.xhigh: A_0 at xhigh effort: score as reported in ext_analysis.json and as recomputed from xhigh.jsonl
summary.json.I0_runs / Ig_runs: held-out score of the final player of each pay-off run (I0 = original coach, Ig = evolved coach)
summary.json.G: I0 mean minus B0 mean with Welch CI {est, lo, hi, df}
summary.json.Delta: Ig mean minus I0 mean with Welch CI
summary.json.extension.per_generation: {gen: {n, mean, lo, hi, scores}} for coaches picked at generation 0/12/20/40 (DESIGN_v2 extension)
summary.json.extension.points: one point per test run: {generation, seed_index, heldout, run}
summary.json.spend: USD: total and by role from analysis.json; by_phase_role recomputed from the ledger
summary.json.final_runs: per pay-off/extension run: final_node, held-out score, finalist candidates and combined (loop+rescore)/2 scores
summary.json.scores: all scores are fractions in [0,1] (task-averaged pass@2)

trees.json.trees[run].arm/seed: arm and seed as they appear in the result rows
trees.json.trees[run].task_set: practice set the loop scored on: source (25 tasks) or payoff (25 tasks)
trees.json.trees[run].frozen_paths: paths the coach could not change (non-empty for pay-off runs: frozen coach)
trees.json.trees[run].coach_origin: for pay-off/extension runs: which source node the frozen coach came from, the selection rule, source_lineage {depth, cum_meta_tokens, cum_meta_calls, cum_meta_cost} of that coach, and its practice score
trees.json.trees[run].final: final player selection: final_node, candidates, combined scores, held-out score
trees.json.trees[run].diff_audit: audited coach-edit hunks for picks from this source run: {pick, file, idx, tag: general|ARC-specific, agreement, reason, node (picked node id), text (the audited hunk: picked coach's code vs I_0, from exp/results/diff_hunks.json)}
trees.json.node.practice_score: loop_score_on_set from nodes.json (practice-set score the loop saw; null = not evaluated/invalid)
trees.json.node.valid: valid_parent flag (could be selected as a parent)
trees.json.node.files_changed: files in this generation's model_patch.diff: {path, role: coach|player|other, added, removed, binary}. coach = meta_agent.py, run_meta_agent.py, agent/**, utils/** (the coach's own helpers, e.g. utils/git_utils.py), tests/test_meta_agent*; player = task_agent.py, run_task_agent.py, domains/**, tests/test_task_agent*; other = pyc, .gitignore, generate_loop.py, stray files
trees.json.node.coach_files_changed_vs_I0: from nodes.json: coach files that differ from I_0 in this node's code (cumulative), null if unknown
trees.json.node.diff: the coach's edit (unified diff) for this generation, binary sections removed, capped ~6 KB; diff_truncated / diff_full_chars tell if/how much was cut
trees.json.node.meta: coach work in the step that produced this node (meta_steps.jsonl): {calls, tokens, seconds, rc, ledger_cost}; null for 'initial'
trees.json.node.lineage: {depth, cum_meta_tokens, cum_meta_calls, cum_meta_cost}: coach compute summed over this node and all its ancestors
trees.json.node.practice: player rollouts on the practice set for this node's code: {recomputed_score, n_test_inputs_run, tokens_per_test_input, calls_per_test_input, seconds_per_test_input, per_task: {task: fraction of test inputs solved}}; null if no rows
trees.json.node.is_Ig_pick: this source node is the I_g coach used in payoff_Ig_source_sN
trees.json.node.ext_pick_at: list like ['g20','g40']: extension pick labels that chose this node's coach
trees.json.node.is_final_player / final_candidate /: pay-off runs: whether this node is the final player (took the exam), a finalist, its (loop+rescore)/2 score, and its held-out score

compute.json.runs[]: one entry per held-out evaluation: B0_rep0..2, xhigh, and every pay-off/extension final player
compute.json.generation: coach generation (I0=0, Ig=12, g20=20, g40=40; null for baselines)
compute.json.score / reported_score: recomputed and officially reported held-out score
compute.json.tokens_per_test_input / calls_per_test_i: mean player test-time compute per test input
compute.json.heldout_eval_cost: USD from the ledger for this held-out evaluation
compute.json.improvement_cost: pay-off runs: compute spent to produce the final player (see notes)
compute.json.final_player_lineage: lineage compute of the final player node inside its pay-off run

tasks.json.tasks[id]: {id, set: heldout|source|payoff, arc_split, train: [{input, output}], test: [{input, output}], heldout_mean_solve (held-out only: mean task score over all held-out runs)}; grids are int arrays (0-9 colours)

heldout.json.runs[run]: {label, group, score, has_preds, per_task: {task: score}, results: {task: [per test input record or null]}}
heldout.json.record.c: [attempt1_correct, attempt2_correct] as 0/1; the test input counts as solved if either is 1
heldout.json.record.n / tok / calls / sec: answers returned, player tokens, model calls, seconds for this test input
heldout.json.record.timeout / err: present only when the player timed out / raised an error
heldout.json.record.p: only when has_preds: [pred_attempt1, pred_attempt2]; a grid (int array) or null (no answer); '=1' means attempt 2 equals attempt 1

transcripts.json.player[]: {kind:'player', run, node, generation, task, test_input, task_set, correct, n_answers, agent_error, answers (wrong answer grids the player returned), why (selection reason), segments: [{role: Input|Output|Refinement input|...|Error|Elided, text}], full_chars}
transcripts.json.solved_replays[]: {kind:'pred_only', run, node, generation, task, test_input, task_set, correct:true, answers:[grid,grid], attempt_correct, tokens, calls, why}
transcripts.json.coach[]: {kind:'coach', run, node, generation, parent, practice_score, parent_practice_score, files_changed, why, segments: [{role: Input|Output|Tool output|Nudge|Elided, text}], full_chars}
transcripts.json.evolution_series[]: {run, task, test_input}: tasks whose transcripts are included at several generations of the same run
